sections.heading: Cars, transport and travel
sections.text:
Deductions for car, transport and travel expenses you incur in the course of your work.

When you can and can't claim deductions for the cost of transport while working and between home and work.

Deductions for work-related use of your car or another motor vehicle

Deductions for work-related transport expenses such as flights, trips by train, bus, taxi or ride-share, and tolls.

Income you must declare, deductions you can claim and records to keep if you receive an award transport payment.

Work-related travel expenses, records you need to keep, travel allowances and record keeping exceptions.

You can't claim a deduction for removal or relocation costs to transfer or relocate for work purposes.
